errors.evidence: The description identifies the category axis as the horizontal axis. In this horizontal bar chart, the category axis (listing the poems) is the vertical axis.
The description identifies the value axis as the vertical axis. In this horizontal bar chart, the value axis (representing the difficulty score) is the horizontal axis.
The description incorrectly identifies the poem with the shortest bar as '《辋下曲四首一（五绝乐府）》'. The correct name shown in the figure is '《塞下曲四首一（五绝乐府）》'.
